camembert_l2.description: Flat classifier over all L2 subcategories

l1_classifier.description: Classifies into 157 L1 categories (used as router for XGBoost)

xgboost.description: Uses CLS embeddings from L1 encoder as features; predicts L2 within predicted L1 class

setfit.reason: Poorly calibrated confidence — 4.87% accuracy on overrides despite high reported confidence

lora.reason: L1 routing errors cascade — 1.2% accuracy on specialist-handled samples

generative.reason: 7.3% accuracy vs CamemBERT's 27.6% on same uncertain samples

final_system.name: max_conf hybrid (CamemBERT L2 + XGBoost)
final_system.description: For each sample: CamemBERT L2 predicts subcategory. If cam_conf < 0.9, also run L1 classifier to route to XGBoost. Pick whichever model (CamemBERT or XGBoost) is more confident.
final_system.override_rule: use XGBoost prediction when xgb_conf > cam_conf

modes_tested.gated: XGBoost overrides only if xgb_conf > cam_conf AND cam_conf < threshold
modes_tested.always_xgb: XGBoost always overrides when cam_conf < threshold
modes_tested.max_conf: Always pick whoever is more confident (threshold-independent)

best_combination.note: Threshold-independent — same result at all thresholds
